desc:
🏈 LEGACY COLLEGE FOOTBALL 🏈
Play real college football with all 134 FBS schools, real rosters and authentic stadiums.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Play Now vs CPU: pick your school and your opponent, 4 difficulty levels plus custom sliders
• Head to Head: take your team online against other players
• Real playbooks: audibles, hot routes, play flips and pre-snap motion
• Icon passing or full manual aiming, with lob and bullet throws
• Real line play: a true pocket, blocking, shedding and anchoring
• Ball carrier moves: jukes, spins, trucks, stiff arms and hurdles
• Real rules: false starts, offsides, illegal motion and real penalty enforcement
• A smart CPU that plays the clock, the down and the score
• 100+ real stadiums and home, away and alternate uniforms
• Sim to the end, spectate or switch sides anytime
• A tutorial with drills for new players

COMING SOON
• DYNASTY: coach a real school for years
• ULTIMATE TEAM: build your squad from player cards

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for updates!
